text:
maria: Heads-up — pen-test window Wed 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC. Need RBAC temporary elevations for assessors, KMS access for evidence export, and an audit log snapshot plan. Anyone available to run the pre-flight checklist tomorrow?

sam: I'm available. Which roles to grant? Prefer ephemeral roles via our KMS-proxy flow.

lee: Minimal blast radius: create a `pt-assessor` role scoped to read-only on logs + read on s3 prefix `redwood-pt-evidence/6274509876/`. No write to prod. Also export CloudTrail before the window.

assessor-jane: We'll need read access to CloudTrail, application logs, and ability to decrypt KMS-wrapped artifacts for evidence verification. Can we get presigned upload URLs for evidence ingestion?

maria: Proposed plan:
1) Provision `pt-assessor` ephemeral IAM role for 4h via our token broker.
2) Create a delegated KMS key alias `alias/pt-evidence` and add a timeboxed grant for the role (Decrypt only).
3) Export last 7 days of audit logs to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/6274509876/ (locked prefix).
4) Enable verbose query tracing for 1h pre-window.
Anyone object?

sam: +1. For KMS: create a customer-managed key with a strict key policy and only allow `kms:Decrypt` when principal == `arn:aws:iam::...:role/pt-assessor` and condition `aws:CurrentTime` window. We'll add a grant so we can revoke it quickly.

lee: Also toggle distributed tracing sampling to keep full traces for any flagged requests during the window. Copy exported logs to a long-term bucket with 90d retention for audit.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created — `pt-evidence-export-627`. Runs 2026-04-07T07:30Z -> exports CloudTrail + app logs -> uploads to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/6274509876/ (presigned links will be posted to this thread).

maria: RBAC change process: we'll use ephemeral PR flow in `infra/iam` and require 2 approvers (sec + infra). I can open the PR now and tag reviewers.

assessor-jane: Retest coordination: once fixes are in, we expect a retest within 10 business days. Suggest tracking via a JIRA epic `PT-627` and creating tickets per finding with labels `pt:high|medium|low`. Attach the evidence S3 links and remediation notes to each ticket.

lee: Agreed — use the security triage board. We'll also tag infra PRs with `pt-627` so the deployment audit trail is searchable.

sam: When generating presigned URLs, set `x-amz-expires=604800` (7d) and require `kms:ViaService` conditions. After export, post links in this thread and in the JIRA tickets.

assessor-jane: Request a live on-call channel for the window in case we need immediate rollbacks. Who is oncall Wed morning?

maria: Oncall is @ryan. I'll ping him now. Also ensure PagerDuty escalation has sec on-call as a secondary.

ryan: I can cover the window 07:00-13:00Z. If anything high-risk shows, page `sec-signal`. I'll be standing by.

maria: Final operational ask: run a dry-run export tomorrow at 07:30Z to validate grants, presign, and decrypt workflow. If the dry-run passes, we proceed.

assessor-jane: Dry-run OK for me — I'll verify decrypt of a test artifact and confirm.

sam: I'll open the key grant + ephemeral role PRs and link here for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: post-window automated revoke scheduled at 2026-04-07T12:15Z (revokes key grants, deletes ephemeral role sessions). Please confirm manual checks after revoke.

maria: Thanks all — I'll file the `PT-627` epic and drop links here. Let's keep commentary to this thread during prep so reviewers have context. :thumbsup:
